topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: This section outlines the lecture aims, background, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Autonomy and Pathway Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how mutations in major cell signaling cascades confer self-sufficiency in growth signals and insensitivity to anti-growth signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how impaired cellular differentiation arrests cells in proliferative progenitor states in both hematological and epithelial cancers.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This section details the molecular mechanisms and regulatory balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic factors enabling cancer cell survival.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cells overcome telomere shortening and normal stress-induced senescence pathways to achieve unlimited replication.

topics.label: Deregulated Cellular Metabolism and the Warburg Effect
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolic pathways to support rapid growth and how metabolic mutations alter cellular regulation.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the requirement, timing, and molecular regulation of new blood vessel recruitment to sustain growing tumors.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the biological stages, physical and environmental constraints, and diagnostic biomarkers of tumor metastasis.

topics.label: Conclusion and Final Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This section provides concluding remarks on the integrative nature of cancer hallmarks and finishes the lecture.
